_comment: Reviewed classification of each desk research source family into a public evidence class.
Family names must match desks/registry.json research.source_families[].name exactly.
'production' is never assignable here: only a manifest under desks/ validated by core.manifests can make a source production.
source_slug must be declared in config/shadow_source_workflow_bindings.json; the shadow manifest it names supplies language tags and rights statements.
basis cites the recorded evidence that supports the class. It is a pointer, not new evidence.
